sample: deterministic synthetic metadata + labelled synthetic assets

pages.intent: Centered title, traditional typography and restrained rules.
pages.structuralDesign: Centered composition: serif title block between twin 1 pt rules, centered logo at the head, organization line above the title, synopsis below the subtitle, centered 2-column label/value metadata pairs near the foot, and a quiet formal palette.

pages.intent: Generous whitespace, quiet hierarchy and minimal decoration.
pages.structuralDesign: Whitespace-led composition: small top-left logo, one 0.5 pt hairline, a left-anchored regular-weight sans title low on the page, synopsis at the lower left, and a single compact inline metadata baseline near the foot — the only one-rule, no-band theme.

pages.intent: Strong horizontal bands and clearly separated information zones.
pages.structuralDesign: Banded composition: full-width dark top band (organization + logo reversed) and matching bottom band containing a 3-column metadata row, with a bold left-aligned title and synopsis in the open middle zone between the bands.

pages.intent: Precise alignment and a structured metadata/document-code grid.
pages.structuralDesign: Grid composition: full-height left sidebar block, top-left title above a heavy 2 pt rule, organization in the middle zone, a 3-column bordered metadata cell grid with 4 mm gutters, synopsis spanning the grid width, and corner-grid logo placement.

pages.intent: Asymmetrical or split-column title and information layout.
pages.structuralDesign: Split composition: colored left panel (38% width) holding logo, organization, stacked metadata and synopsis in reversed ink; wide right column carries a large serif title and subtitle left-anchored mid-page; a 1.5 pt rule marks the split.

pages.intent: Deliberate background-image treatment with readable foreground contrast.
pages.structuralDesign: Hero composition: full-bleed background image (or quiet fallback block) under a dark bottom scrim band; bold reversed title and subtitle inside the scrim, organization + logo overlaid top-left, and a 3-column metadata footer strip below the title zone.

pages.intent: Structured border, formal logo placement and metadata alignment.
pages.structuralDesign: Framed composition: nested 0.75 pt inner frame inside the user frame, centered logo at the frame head above a hairline, centered serif title block mid-frame, synopsis at the frame foot, and a bordered 2-column metadata block anchored at the bottom.

pages.intent: Geometric shapes, rules and carefully composed layout regions.
pages.structuralDesign: Geometric composition: large top-left and secondary corner blocks (34 mm), floating accent shapes, right-anchored organization line, left title block mid-page, metadata in two rule-separated columns, and a synopsis strip over a 3 pt full-width accent rule.

pages.intent: Journal-like hierarchy, compact metadata and abstract region.
pages.structuralDesign: Journal composition: running head with logo right and a 1.25 pt journal rule, compact top-left title with italic subtitle, organization/author line, a bordered abstract box for the synopsis, and a compact single-column key/value metadata list.

pages.intent: Dense but ordered layout for procedures and administrative documents.
pages.structuralDesign: Record composition: bordered 3-row document-control header table at the top with logo right, left title and subtitle beneath, a full-width bordered 2-column metadata control table, and a boxed administrative note region for the synopsis.
